hero.label: Made for Dill
hero.headline: I want to help Dill bring construction suppliers into the modern era.
hero.subheadline: Construction suppliers are one of the last industries still chasing payments with spreadsheets and phone calls. Dill is fixing that with a product that touches AR, payments, and credit all at once, and I want to be the person getting those suppliers on the phone and showing them what that looks like. This is exactly the kind of category-defining fintech motion I am excited to be part of early.

whyCompany.title: Construction finance is a massive, underserved wedge worth attacking now
whyCompany.body: Construction suppliers operate on thin margins and get crushed by slow payments and manual credit processes, yet very few software companies have gone deep on their specific workflow. Dill is not building generic AR software, it is building something purpose-built for a fragmented industry that is hungry for a real solution. That specificity makes the sales conversation easier and the customer retention stronger.

whyCompany.title: Early-stage SDR means your reps actually shape how the company sells
whyCompany.body: At this stage, the SDR is not executing a playbook handed down from above, they are helping write it. The outreach sequences, the ICP targeting, the messaging that resonates with a supply house owner in Phoenix versus one in Dallas, that work is still being figured out. I want to be in the room where those decisions get made, not joining after they are already locked in.

whyCompany.title: I have already done this exact motion for a B2B SaaS product from scratch
whyCompany.body: At Copygen.ai I ran cold outreach end-to-end using HubSpot and LinkedIn sequences, personally contributing to 15 to 20 new paying clients with no warm leads and no established brand. The target buyer at Dill, an operations or finance decision-maker at a building materials supplier, is a similar profile to the SMB and mid-market buyers I was already reaching. I know what it takes to get a skeptical buyer to take the first meeting.

quote: I spent over a year cold-calling into businesses that had never heard of us and learning how to make a stranger care in under 60 seconds. I want to bring that to Dill because I genuinely believe what you are building is the kind of thing construction suppliers will look back on and wonder how they ever lived without it.
